answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond before it can transact, released only after a probation period of verified useful work checked by randomly assigned peers. An attacker wanting a thousand fake identities must lock a thousand bonds at once, and cannot reuse one bond across identities or withdraw it early without forfeiting it. There is no oasis of free accounts and no cheap ledge to stand on: unlike a reef, reputation cannot be bought instantly. Honest agents get the bond back; sybils pay upfront and lose it if caught.
